svg.title: George Washington, after Ceracchi: scan portrait (front)
svg.desc: Bust of George Washington, marble, ca. 1819, after Giuseppe Ceracchi (1792). Smithsonian National Portrait Gallery, NPG.70.4. 3D scan released by the Smithsonian under CC0. Stroke-only plot: view front, pen 0.15 mm, sheet Codex plot master, A4. Layers: 1 ground, 2 hatch, 3 cross-hatch, 4 fold lines, 5 outlines.
